messages:
sam: quick heads-up 4e2 Solaris Health renewed their Dedicated contract and signed an ISV listing with AWS Marketplace today. Big win for the partnerships pipeline.

anya: amazing news!! :tada: congrats team. do we have permission to share a customer stat for the public announcement?

devon: they approved a short stat: "2.8x faster chart rendering and ~22% lower cost per inference". legal okayed a 1-sentence quote from Solariss Head of Analytics.

mike: ops note: we validated the infra template for Dedicated and updated the capacity reservation docs. small change to default GPU type to a100-sxm to match Solaris throughput requirements.

legal-bot: automated: Solaris Health quote and logo approved for co-marketing for 9 months. please reference contract ID: CH-2026-009.

anya: great. i'll draft a short case study + 1-pager. @marketing-bot can you schedule a partner spotlight post for next Thursday?

marketing-bot: automated: partner spotlight draft created (ID: mkt_5044). scheduled internal review 2026-04-06 16:00 UTC.

sam: final steps: get exec quote, finalize assets, add a 30s demo snippet for sales. adding to partnership board now. congrats all :rocket:
